prompt:
A minimalist recipe card illustration for ginger root tea. Flat-lay top-down view of a single hand-thrown ceramic mug filled with warm honey-amber ginger tea, placed slightly off-center (upper right). Scattered around the mug on a bone #F7EFE2 surface: two knobby fresh ginger root pieces (warm tan with rough texture), three thin ginger slices showing pale yellow flesh, one star anise pod, and a small pour of golden honey. The composition breathes — at least half the image is clean empty bone-colored surface. No utensils, no saucers, no text, no steam.

RENDERING STYLE: Clean modern illustration — flat base colors with smooth soft-shaded gradients. Ginger silhouettes are confident and clean, NOT painterly. NO watercolor bleeds, NO paper grain, NO sketchy lines. The mug has a subtle amber glazed rim. Warm diffuse morning light from upper left casts a faint soft shadow below the mug. Feels warming, restorative, hand-prepared. Recipe card thumbnail — subject must read at small sizes.
